name: Ichalkaranji Municipal Corporation
headquarters: Station Road, beside Guru Talkies, Vikas Nagar, Ichalkaranji, Maharashtra 416115
description: Municipal government for Ichalkaranji in Hatkanangale taluka, Kolhapur district. The corporation was constituted from the whole former municipal council area with effect from 29 June 2022. Its January 2026 general election covered 65 seats across 16 wards.
